title: Rabbi Chakhinai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: The father of the Tanna known as Rabbi Chananya ben Chakhinai: Kilayim 4:8. He is mentioned in Pirkei deRabbi Eliezer, chapters 41 and 49, as Rabbi Chakhinai. Seder HaDorot cites a Rabbi Chakhinai, an Amora, who spoke in Rabbi Levi’s name, from the old Tanchuma, Tazria; Hyman proposes the reading as in Tanchuma Buber, Tazria 11: “Rabbi Berekhyah in the name of Rabbi Levi.”

notes.text: The full Rabbi Levi form in the connected named Tanchuma Buber witness supports this occurrence’s abbreviation. Hyman’s proposed correction is still attributed and does not establish another person’s identity automatically.
